title: Spelling suggestions
description: Misspelled words get a red squiggle. Put the cursor on one and press Tab for 3 suggestions, or add the word to your dictionary.

title: Autocomplete
description: After 2 letters, up to 3 words show up above the field. Tab picks one, Space takes it.

title: Settings
description: Open with /bettertyping or from Mod Menu: turn features on or off, change the shortcuts, tick your languages and edit your personal dictionary.

title: Language list
description: Tick every language you write in. English (US and UK) comes with the mod. German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Swedish, Russian, Hebrew and Arabic are downloaded when ticked, about 1 MB each.
